subject: Packaging discount triggers & true-up protocol — Exhibit pricing questions
messages:
From: Ravi Narayan <ravi.narayan@orionhealth.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@orionhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Packaging discounts — need clarity on triggers and rollback

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — Orion's finance and procurement teams reviewed the draft order form and have a couple of open items on the pricing annex. Specifically:

- The "Pack Bundle Discount" (Section 3.2) references a net-new SKUs threshold but doesn't define whether seasonal bundles count toward the threshold during promotional quarters.
- The proposed true-up language allows Redwood to recalculate effective discounts at quarter-end; we're looking for a clearer rollback protocol if the bundle discount was used during a promotional event but actual committed usage falls below the threshold post-event.

I've attached a redline of Exhibit B (pricing annex) that highlights proposed edits from our procurement counsel. Can your legal and pricing team confirm whether Redwood is willing to accept a 30-day remediation window before any rollback or retroactive price adjustments are applied?

We'd like to avoid surprise retro-billing for revenue recognition purposes. Also copying Laura Jensen from finance for visibility.

Appreciate a short call if helpful — we have a procurement checkpoint on Friday.

Thanks,
Ravi
Ravi Narayan
Head of Procurement
Orion Health AI
Attachment: Exhibit-Pricing-Annex-Redline.docx (docx)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>
To: Ravi Narayan <ravi.narayan@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging discounts — need clarity on triggers and rollback

Hi Ravi — thanks for sending the redline and for the clear bullets. Looping in Marissa (legal) and Karthik (pricing) to confirm. Quick thoughts up front:

- We generally treat promotional bundles as eligible for the Pack Bundle Discount if they are included in the official SKU map for the contract period; however, we typically exclude one-off marketing credits or pilot-only SKUs.
- On rollback/true-up: we can accept a remediation window but need to align on the mechanics. Proposal: 30-day notice period + opportunity to cure via a usage make-good or credit, followed by pro-rated rollback only on the incremental discount amount. That avoids full retroactive reset.

Marissa / Karthik — can you review the attached redline and confirm whether the 30-day cure + pro-rata rollback is acceptable from legal/pricing perspective? If not, what alternate language would you propose?

If easier, happy to set a 20-minute call with Orion procurement tomorrow.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Ravi Narayan <ravi.narayan@orionhealth.ai>, Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@orionhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging discounts — need clarity on triggers and rollback

Mateo / team — reviewed Orion's redline and flagged a few items inline. High level: we can accept a defined remediation/cure period before applying any financial rollback, but we want to limit the maximum lookback to one quarter (i.e., no more than 90 days of retroactive adjustments) and preserve Redwood's right to offset credits against future invoices.

Suggested contract language (summary):
- "In the event Orion's usage falls below the Bundled SKU threshold triggering Pack Bundle Discount, Redwood will provide written notice and a 30-day cure period during which Orion may make up the shortfall through additional usage or elect a one-time invoice credit. If no cure is provided, Redwood may apply a pro-rated rollback for the quarter in which the shortfall occurred, limited to 90 days of retroactive adjustment. Credits or rollback amounts will be netted against future invoices."

We should also clarify the definition of "promotional SKU" — propose adding a clause that promotional SKUs must be mutually agreed in writing and documented in the MAP (Mutual Action Plan) to be counted toward bundle thresholds. That avoids month-to-month disputes.

Karthik — confirm the pro-rata calculation formula and whether pricing needs an exception for seasonal promotions that span two quarters.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: Exhibit-Pricing-Annex-Redline.docx (redline comments inline)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Ravi Narayan <ravi.narayan@orionhealth.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging discounts — need clarity on triggers and rollback

Thanks Marissa — pricing has a couple of operational caveats. Proposed math to include in the annex (plain-English + formula):

- Calculation: If B = bundled-discount baseline (committed bundles), A = actual eligible bundle usage in quarter, and D = discount percentage applied during promotional period, then rollback amount = max(0, (A-B)) * list-price * D_proportional where D_proportional = (D * (actual eligible bundle usage / promotional bundle usage)).
- Operational exception: for promotions that cross quarter boundaries, we will pro-rate eligibility based on the number of days of the promotion in each quarter.
- True-up timing: quarter-end reconciliation, invoice adjustment applied on the next monthly billing cycle after notice/cure window expires.

I'll add worked examples to the MAP spreadsheet so Orion can validate with their finance team. Mateo — attaching the MAP worksheet with the sample calculation and an example rollback scenario. Suggest we add the sentence Marissa proposed about promotional SKUs requiring mutual written confirmation and a place in the MAP to list them.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Pricing Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP-Orion-HealthAI.xlsx (sample calc tab)
From: Ravi Narayan <ravi.narayan@orionhealth.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging discounts — need clarity on triggers and rollback

Team — this looks very reasonable and addresses our main accounting concerns. A few action items on our side:

1) We'll have finance review Karthik's worked examples on the MAP and confirm the pro-rate approach by Wednesday.
2) We agree to the 30-day cure window and 90-day max lookback; please add the explicit offset/netting language so our revenue ops folks can reconcile.
3) We'll update the redline Exhibit to mark promotional SKUs as "to be included in MAP" and upload the signed MAP once mutually confirmed.

Can Redwood prepare a short clause to drop into Exhibit B with the exact wording Marissa suggested (we can then run one final pass in DocuSign). If you can share a draft clause today we'll circulate internally and try to keep the Friday procurement checkpoint.

Thanks for the speedy collaboration.
Ravi
